text: {"name": "get_frame_type_status", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Switches on a descriptor byte at offset 169 and encodes nearby descriptor fields into a 16-bit frame/status word.", "subsystem": "mac", "var_renames": {"a1": "desc", "v2": "field_177", "v3": "field_194_flag"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 169, "meaning": "frame/type selector byte"}, {"offset": 177, "meaning": "type-dependent status/parameter field; zero selects 0x0400"}, {"offset": 182, "meaning": "optional flag encoded as bit 10 for type 0/1"}, {"offset": 183, "meaning": "optional flag selecting 0x3A80 versus 0x2A00 for type 5"}, {"offset": 194, "meaning": "optional flag ORed as bit 14"}]}
